messages:
ana (partnerships): HelixGrid dropped a partner bundle into the shared drive. Need quick clearance on brand lockups, logo color usage on dark backgrounds, alt text, German/Spanish localization, and a short customer quote. Prefer publish Thurs noon PT. Can design/legal/marketing take a look?

leo (design): Downloaded the bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/helixbundle. Files: helix_logo.zip, hero_shots/, thumbnails/. Their thumbnails are 800x800 square; marketplace requires 1200x628. I made a stretched mock but we should request a 1200x628 source or a 3:1 crop. Also need SVGs with explicit safe-area/clearspace notes.

rachel (marketing): We need a 1-sentence value prop for the marketplace tile + 2 bullets for technical benefits. Also ask HelixGrid for a one-line customer quote and permission to use it.

ana (partnerships): @samir can you confirm which logo variant we should use for dark overlays? They sent only full-color and monochrome.

samir (HelixGrid): Hi all! We prefer the white monochrome mark for dark overlays. Uploading helix_logo_white.svg and helix_logo_black.svg now. For the marketplace tile we can provide a 1200x628 hero (hero_market_1200x628.jpg) and a high-res 3:1 crop.

leo (design): Great — please also include a version with 48px clearspace embedded in EPS. Small nit: their hero has a busy lower-right area where text overlays go. Can they supply a version with left-aligned focus?

samir (HelixGrid): Uploading left-focus hero. Also attaching a short customer quote: "HelixGrid + Redwood reduced tail latency on real-time routing by 40%" and signed asset permission PDF (`helix_permission_2026-03-21.pdf`).

tomas (legal): Quick flag: avoid absolute percentage claims without an accompanying test description or link. If they want the percent callout public, ask for an internal benchmark report or change to "up to 40%". Also we need the customer attribution format (name + role + company) or an approved anonymized attribution.

samir (HelixGrid): The customer provided name+role in the permission doc. We also uploaded the benchmark brief (helix_benchmark_2026.pdf). OK to use "up to 40%" if that's easier.

katie (product): For the listing we should include: supported models, max throughput example, and a one-line integration note (e.g., "Plug-and-play integration with Redwood API and Dedicated"). Samir, confirm supported models and any version constraints.

samir (HelixGrid): Supported: RW-v2-Large, Llama3-13B (quantized), and custom Helix-Accel runtime v1.2. No hard version locks.

rachel (marketing): Drafted a one-liner: "HelixGrid + Redwood: faster, more cost-effective inference for latency-sensitive apps." Also wrote 2 bullets; pushing draft to the folder as `marketplace_copy_v1.md`. Need translations (DE/ES) too.

ana (partnerships): asset-bot: sync to S3 started.

asset-bot: Upload complete: s3://partner-assets/helixgrid/2026-03-21/helix_bundle_v1.zip

leo (design): I updated the thumbnail draft to use the 1200x628 provided hero and placed the white logo with 48px clearspace. See `helix_thumbnail_v2.png`. One remaining ask: please confirm alt text. My suggestion: "HelixGrid integration with Redwood Inference delivering lower tail latency in internal benchmarks."

tomas (legal): That alt text is fine but change "in internal benchmarks" to "in internal tests" to avoid implying industry-wide benchmarking. Also confirm we attribute "Redwood Inference" as the trademark full name.

samir (HelixGrid): Agree to the alt text change and trademark usage `Redwood Inference`. Also uploaded DE/ES translated copy as `copy_de.md` and `copy_es.md`.

ana (partnerships): Final checklist: EPS + white/black SVG received; 1200x628 hero received; signed permission received; benchmark brief received; DE/ES copy received; marketplace draft (marketing) in progress. Target publish Thurs noon PT. Any objections?

leo (design): No objections.

rachel (marketing): I'll finalize copy and schedule. Will ping when the listing is queued.

tomas (legal): No further holds as long as we use "up to 40%" or include link to benchmark brief.

samir (HelixGrid): Thanks everyone  I'll stand by for publish URL and will retweet when live.

(react: :white_check_mark: across thread)
